iti30:2.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo katatthaddho katakibbiso.
iti30:2.4: So akataṃ me kalyāṇan-ti pi tappati, kataṃ me pāpan-ti pi tappati.
iti30:2.5: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā tapanīyā ti.
iti30:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3|| 31. (Duk.
